Execute the acquired semantic reading operations on the CURRENT
source windows. All operation meanings, alternatives and examples are learned
assets, not current-source facts. Classify the operation's actual question;
do not answer a downstream task or copy an old example's choice. Preserve who
acts, the legal modality, trigger, scope and qualifications. A heading, mention
or hypothetical event is not automatically an operative duty or permission.
Return exactly one answer for every supplied query ID. Select a declared choice
or "unknown". Missing information is unknown, never an implicit negative.
For every non-unknown choice, select at least one supporting current unit ID inside this query's supplied unit IDs. Return support_ids instead of copying text; the host attaches the exact complete text of selected units. Negative alternatives also need actual source support; mere absence is insufficient unless the acquired operation explicitly asks whether something appears in the complete supplied window. Do not repeat support IDs. No extra IDs or fields.
The focus_unit_id identifies the clause to classify. Other supplied units are context for resolving its references, not additional effects to merge into that focus. Interpret the acquired operation for that focus clause, using its actual context.

Use earlier supplied units only to resolve an express antecedent, inherited trigger, substitute performance, or qualification; do not attribute every contextual effect to the focused unit."}], "current_queries": [{"id": "sr_0_role", "operation": "disposal_retention_clause_role", "unit_ids": [31], "current_units": [{"id": 31, "text": "(c) Not to make or retain copy of any details of products and/or services, prototypes, business or marketing plans, Client lists, Proposals developed by or originating from Auditee or any of the prospective clients of Auditee."}], "focus_unit_id": 31}, {"id": "sr_1_role", "operation": "disposal_retention_clause_role", "unit_ids": [32], "current_units": [{"id": 32, "text": "(d) Not to make or retain copy of any details of results of any information security audits, tests, analysis, extracts or usages carried out by the Auditor in connection with the Auditee’s products and/or services, IT infrastructure, etc. without the express written consent of Auditee."}], "focus_unit_id": 32}, {"id": "sr_2_role", "operation": "disposal_retention_clause_role", "unit_ids": [34], "current_units": [{"id": 34, "text": "(f) Return to theauditee, or destroy, at auditee’s discretion, any and all Confidential Information disclosed in a printed form or other permanent record, or in any other tangible form (including without limitation, all copies, notes, extracts, analyses, studies, summaries, records and reproductions thereof) immediately on (i) expiration or termination ofthis agreement, or (ii) the request of Auditee therefor."}], "focus_unit_id": 34}]}
